name: cz-studio
description: Editor video lokal untuk konten vertikal. Semua aksi AI lewat Claude Code milik kamu.
author: Azmi

scripts.build: vite build apps/web && esbuild apps/server/src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/cli.js --external:fastify --external:@fastify/static --external:immer --external:@remotion/renderer --external:@remotion/bundler --external:esbuild && node scripts/bundle-render.mjs && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('apps/server/builtin','dist/builtin',{recursive:true})"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
